Investment Intern
VCIMCO
Richmond, Virginia

VCIMCO is the investment office that manages the long-term pool on behalf of
Virginia Commonwealth University and its affiliated foundations. The office
invests across public equity, fixed income, private capital, and real assets,
and operates on an endowment model with an external manager structure.

The Investment Intern supports the investment team in manager research and
ongoing due diligence across asset classes. Interns sit with the team, read what
the team reads, and contribute to the written record that goes to the Investment
Committee.

What you will do
- Assist with manager research: performance attribution, peer comparison, and
  review of offering documents
- Maintain and improve the data the team relies on for asset allocation work
- Draft sections of investment memoranda and prepare materials for the
  Investment Committee
- Follow markets and summarize developments relevant to the long-term pool

What we look for
- Rising junior or senior pursuing a degree in finance, economics, accounting,
  or a quantitative field
- Comfort with spreadsheets and an interest in institutional investing
- Careful writing; the office runs on memos
- Curiosity about how capital gets allocated at an institution

Hours: approximately 15 hours per week during the academic year
Pay: $20/hr

Applications due October 14, 2026
